detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Anime style, cinematic lighting, a medium shot frames a young pink-haired woman in a blue T-shirt sitting on a white ceramic bidet at 0.00 seconds. The camera is static. She faces forward with both hands resting on her knees, wearing the same blue T-shirt shown in <Picture 1> that extends above her hips while her lower body remains bare and her feet are bare. Behind her and to her right are marble walls. The floor is covered in white tiles. On the right marble wall, three white control buttons are vertically aligned, labeled "Stop" (top), "Normal" (middle), and "Max" (bottom). She has a curious expression, her bright green eyes gazing upward at the wall-mounted buttons. Water droplets glisten on her skin.

[Shot 1] At 00:02.000, the camera remains static as she extends her left index finger downward and presses the "Normal" button on the wall.

[Shot 1] At 00:03.000, a gentle water column sprays upward from the bidet toward her lower body. She immediately clasps her legs together quickly to prevent the water from spraying out, her expression tightening with tension. Her blue T-shirt stays in place.

[Shot 1] At 00:04.000, she closes her eyes with an expression of enjoyment and relieves. Her hands relax gracefully onto her thighs. A small smile forms as the water column continues its gentle rhythm.

[Shot 1] At 00:06.000, she opens her eyes with an eager, expectant expression. She extends her left index finger upward once more and presses the "Max" button. Her lips part slightly.

[Shot 1] At 00:07.000, she tilts her head downward, gazing at her thighs, with her right hand still resting on her thigh and her left hand moving to the side of her head. Her expression is slightly surprised.

[Shot 1] At 00:08.000, a powerful water column erupts from the bidet directly toward her buttocks. The force lifts her upward from the bidet. Her hands flail desperately at her sides, and her expression shifts to panic. Her twin tails sway with the motion.

[Shot 1] At 00:10.000, the water spray ceases. She tumbles forward, landing face-down with her buttocks raised high on the white-tiled floor in front of the bidet. A faint pink mark appears on her forehead from the impact.

[Shot 2] At 00:12.000, the camera arcs around her with small amplitude at slow speed as she kneels on the white-tiled floor, face pressed against the ground and buttocks facing the camera. The view clearly shows her bare lower body — her pubic area and anus are visible from behind. She wears only the blue T-shirt. Her twin tails cascade behind her. As the camera continues its arc, between 00:14.000 and 00:15.000, she turns her head over her shoulder toward the camera with a pouty, dissatisfied expression. A small pink bruise mark is visible on her forehead. Her green eyes lock onto the viewer, her cheeks flushed with embarrassment and determination. The camera maintains its focus on her buttocks throughout the movement. The marble walls and white-tiled floor reflect the ambient light. Her pink twin-tailed hair with black bows frames her face beautifully.

Her bare legs and buttocks make soft impacts against the white-tiled floor. Water droplets patter on her skin and the tiles. Her twin tails sway with a light rustling sound as she moves. A soft thud echoes when she falls face-down.
